newsitem.title: USA: Telscape says names Binet as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Telscape says names Binet as CFO.

text.p: Telscape International Inc said on Monday that its chief financial officer Mark Vance had been replaced by Todd Binet.

The company also announced that Gary Panno and Christopher Efird had resigned as directors. Telscape said that Panno stepped down to allow for succession as his involvement in the company has diminished subsequent to his resignation as chief financial officer. Efird resigned in connection with the complete sale of his holdings in the company.
Telscape, which was formerly known as Polish Telephones and Microwave International Inc, named Manuel Landa as chairman in November. The company merged with Orion Communications in August.
